scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic calculations and a proof of the generic square-class independence accompany the result; finite examples do not serve as proof of prime densities. This is not an independently validated finding.
scientific_limitations: Five-node generic open locus and the stated single rational Howe specialization only; no complete classification of exceptional degenerations or all bad reduction primes. Geometric node configurations and the underlying sextic equation are credited to the originating literature. Prime densities apply to rational singular points, not rational points of the curve.
title: Biquadratic Galois action on the generic five-node Howe sextic, with an explicit prime-density specialization
